translation.name: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau
translation.englishName: Kilivila: Buki Pilabumaboma Kabutubogwa Deli Kabutuvau Bible

content: Samwela ibulami Debida paila biguyau

E Guyau ilivala baisa Samwela kawala, “Ammakawala kala kaduwonaku m ninamwau bisisu paila Saulo? Yeigu bogwa lapaiki matauna biguyoi mina Isireli. Mitaga baisa tuta kukwau sitana bulami olibe e bukula Bedeliem, e bukubani taitala tau yagala Yese. Paila bogwa lanagi taitala latula matauna biguyau.”

Samwela ikatupoi, “Ammakawala bavagi baisa? Kidamwa Saulo bilagi, e matauna bikatumataigu!” Guyau ivitakauloki matauna kawala, “Kukwau natana bulumakau namwala kulau e kulivala mwada lokula baisa paila bukulula baisa Guyau.
E kudou Yese biwa wa lula makwaina, e yeigu balukwaim avaka bukuvagi. Ka, balukwaim bukuvaputumi taitala tau paila biguyau.”
Samwela ivagi wala makawala avaka Guyau eiluki bivagi, e ila Bedeliem, e baisa goli kaidadala valu ibodaisi matauna deli si tatuva, e ikatupoiyaisi matauna kawasi, “Mwa! Tokalamimi,
ki, lokuma paila bitaveyawasi kaina?”

Matauna ivitakauloki matausina kawala, “Mitaga! Ka, yeigu lama paila balula baisa Guyau. Kukikilaimi e bukubokulaigusi.” Tuvaila goli iluki Yese deli litula kidamwa bikikilaisi titoulesi, e idou matausina bilosi deli matauna ilulasi.
Avai tuta Yese deli litula iviloubusisi, e Samwela igisi kuluta, matauna Eliabi, e inanamsa, “Ka, matauwena tau eitotu baisa Guyau omatala, e adoki mokwita wala matauna bogwa einagi.”

Mitaga Guyau iluki matauna kawala, “Taga bikau nanom paila kala towonaku deli kala tominabwaita. Yeigu bogwa lapaiki matauna. Paila yeigu ulo naga gala makawala tomota si naga. Tomota bigisaisi woula avaka kala gigisa wala, mitaga yeigu agigisi nona.”
Oluvi Yese idou latula Abinadaba imakaia Samwela. E Samwela ikaibiga kawala, “Gala! Guyau gala inagi matauna.”
Tuvaila Yese ivakouli Samma imiaki Samwela e Samwela iluki kawala, “Gala wala, Guyau gala inagi matauna.”
E bogwa makawala Yese litula kasitailima kasitaiyu imiaki Samwela. E Samwela iluki matauna, kawala, “Gala, Guyau gala wala inagi taitala matausina.”

E oluvi Samwela ikatupoi Yese, kawala, “Ki, sitana litumwa tuvaila kaina gala?” Yese ivitakauloki, kawala, “Taitala tuvaila matauna kasusu, mitaga matauna gala isisu baisa, bogwa leila iiyamata sipi.” E Samwela ikaibiga, kawala, “Kuluki matauna bima baisa, paila gala bitagabwaisi lula tatoula wala matauna bima.”
Mapaila Yese iwitali biga mwada matauna bima. E matauna totubovau, e tominabwaita deli tomatuwa, e matala goli kwegigigia. E Guyau iluki Samwela, kawala, “E, matauna! Kuvaputumi matauna.”

Samwela ikau bulamila olibe e ivaputumi Debida omitasi wala tuwʹala komwaidosi. E tuta matutona wala Guyau la baloma isikaili Debida e isisii wala matauna metoya wa yam makwaina e isigaga goli. E Samwela ikaimilavau ola valu Rama.
Debida ilokaia Saulo iwotitali
E Guyau la baloma isilavi Saulo, e baloma gaga Guyau iwitali baisa matauna.
E la touwata ilukwaisi matauna kawasi, “Bogwa lakanikolaisi Yaubada eiwitali baloma gaga baisa yoku e iyomwauwaim.
Ibodi bukukwaraiwogaimasi, e bakalosi kanevisi taitala availa inikoli wawai gita. Kidamwa avai tuta baloma gaga bimakaiam, e matauna tau biwai la gita, e biyomwasali nanom.”
Mapaila Saulo ikaraiwogi matausina, kawala, “Kunevaisi taitala towawai e bukumiakaigusi matauna.”

E taitala matausina la touwata ilivala kawala, “Taitala Yese latula oviluwela Bedeliem matauna saina kala tovagi wawai gita. E ka, tuvaila matauna taitala totuvaluwa deli tomatabwaila matauna, e tokabilia topeula deli goli tobigabwaila, e tuvaila Guyau isikaili matauna.”
Mapaila Saulo iwitali touwata ilauwaisi biga baisa Yese, ilukwaisi matauna kawasi, “Mwa! Latum Debida matauna toyamata sipi - kuwitali matauna bimakaiagu.”
E Yese iwitali Debida ikau natana gota natubovau, e tuvaila ikau beredi, deli goli yatala lukwavala waini isaili otapwala natana ase e iwitali baisa Saulo.
Debida imakaia Saulo e isuvi ola wotetila. E Saulo saina tombwailila matauna, e inagi matauna tokeula la guguwa paila kabilia.
Oluvi Saulo iwitali biga ilokaia Yese. Kawala, “Mwa! Migibwailigu wala Debida. E anigadaim saina magigu Debida basiaim wala ulo towotetila.”

E metoya wa tuta matutona goli kidamwa avai tuta Yaubada biwitali baloma gaga bimakaia Saulo, e Debida bikau la gita biwai. E baloma gaga bogwa bisilavi Saulo, e kala lumkola bibwaina e bimwamwasila nanola.
